objective:
Switch the phone's LOG screen (typed and voice capture) from the old single-activity pipeline to the subject + action tag pipeline, with the cards and pickers that go with it. The pieces below were built and verified in TG3.1-TG3.3; this task is the screen and view-model layer only. History keeps working untouched on the old services until TG3.5 (both service sets coexist in ActivityLedgerApplication/CapturePipeline).

BACKGROUND. Read first: app-phone/.../ui/log/LogViewModel.kt (the whole file: capture path, undo window, speech session rules, runAction, the single write site `createRawCapture`), LogUiState.kt (LogUiState, sealed ResultCard), ResultCards.kt, LogScreen.kt, LogViewModelFactory.kt, ui/components/ActivityPicker.kt, ui/components/HistoryRow.kt, ui/review/* (ReviewSuggestions, PickerState, RefusalMessages), ui/time/OccurrenceTimeFormatter.kt, res/values/strings.xml, and docs/UX_VISUAL_SPEC.md + docs/UX_SPEC.md (result cards, tone, accessibility rules, touch targets: follow the existing visual language exactly; plain everyday words for the owner, never 'canonical', 'interpretation', 'resolve'). Domain pieces now available (core-domain, read their KDoc): `TaggedCaptureOrchestrator.process(captureId)` -> TaggedProcessingOutcome = AutoSaved(occurrenceId) | NeedsConfirm(proposal) | NeedsReview(reasons, problems, proposal?) | Rejected(reasons) | InterpreterUnavailable(kind) | AlreadyHasOccurrence; `TaggedProposal(captureId, extractedSubject, extractedAction, subject: TagResolution, action: TagResolution, subjectInferred, reasons, occurredAt, timePrecision, durationExpression, durationSeconds, activityState)` where TagResolution = Empty | Exact(tag: KnownTag{id,displayName,aliases}, via) | Near(newName, candidates: List<KnownTag>) | New(name); `TaggedResolutionService.resolve(captureId, subject: TagChoice, action: TagChoice, time: OccurrenceTime?, durationSeconds, activityState, words)` -> Resolved(occurrenceId) | Refused(TagRefusal); `TaggedCorrectionService.correct(occurrenceId, subject: TagChoice?, action: TagChoice?, duration: DurationChange?, reason)` -> Applied | NothingChanged | Refused(TagRefusal) (both in services/TaggedResolutionService.kt; TagChoice = Existing(tagId) | New(name) from tagging/CorrectionAliases.kt; TagRefusal in services/TagRefusal.kt); `LedgerRepository.loadTagCatalog()` (TagCatalog: subjects/actions as KnownTag lists, pairs), `getOccurrence`, `getActivity` (ActivityView has subjectId/actionId), `hideOccurrence`, `loadHistory`, `getCapture`, `createRawCapture`. The application class (ActivityLedgerApplication) already exposes `capturePipeline.taggedOrchestrator`, `taggedResolutionService`, `taggedCorrectionService`, `tagManagementService` and `capturePipeline.repository: LedgerRepository`.

PRODUCT BEHAVIOUR (these are the owner-visible decisions; keep to them, put wording in string resources):
1. SAVED card: shows the entry as subject and action, plus the duration when there is one, plus the time, and the owner's own words in the evidence style: e.g. title '✓ Hot tub · Change filter — 30 min — just now' (compose the exact string layout from resources so it reads well when the duration is absent). Buttons: Undo, Change subject, Change action. Undo behaves exactly as today (hides the occurrence, window drains, pauses while touched / picker open / screen stopped). Change subject / Change action opens the TAG PICKER for that kind; choosing applies `TaggedCorrectionService.correct` (existing tag or a typed new name); the card then shows the new names and the undo window keeps running (as changeActivity does today). Names for the card come from the occurrence's pair via the catalog or repository reads (your call; no per-row query storms).
2. ONE 'CHECK THIS' CARD for everything that is not an automatic save, replacing the old NeedsReview and NotCategorized cards: it serves NeedsConfirm (close match: 'Did you mean ...?'), NeedsReview and Rejected (not enough to log silently), and InterpreterUnavailable (words stored, AI not available: both sides blank). It shows the owner's words, the reassurance that nothing was guessed (reuse the existing copy where it still fits), then TWO sides, Subject and Action. For each side show what was understood and what is chosen: a side that resolved Exact or New is PRE-CHOSEN (tap to change); a Near side offers its candidate tags as one-tap options plus 'Keep mine: <words>' (creates a new tag from the owner's words); an Empty side (or no proposal) has nothing chosen and offers 'Choose subject' / 'Choose action' (opens the tag picker). The 'Save' button is enabled only when BOTH sides are chosen; it calls `TaggedResolutionService.resolve` with the chosen TagChoices, `time` = the proposal's occurredAt/timePrecision ONLY when the proposal has a time AND the outcome has no time problem (`problems` contains none of TIME_IN_FUTURE / TIME_UNRESOLVABLE; else null = capture time), `durationSeconds` and `activityState` from the proposal (state default COMPLETED when null). 'Decide later' dismisses the card; the capture stays waiting (History shows it; TG3.5). The sides' pre-chosen/inferred wording: when `subjectInferred` is true show it as chosen but marked as 'assumed from your usual ...' style plain wording (your wording, short). Nothing is saved until Save is tapped.
3. TAG PICKER (new shared composable beside ActivityPicker, e.g. ui/components/TagPicker.kt): a modal sheet like ActivityPicker, parameterised by kind (Subject/Action) with kind-specific title/search/new-name strings; lists the ACTIVE tags of that kind from `loadTagCatalog()` (name only; filter-as-you-type, case-insensitive 'contains' on name AND aliases like ActivityPicker's filter), and lets the owner type a NEW name; returns a `TagChoice`. Same accessibility/touch-target standards and test tags as ActivityPicker (own tag constant). Do not change ActivityPicker (History still uses it).
4. Durations are shown in plain words from seconds ('30 min', '1 h 15 min', '2 h'): a small pure formatter with unit tests and string resources (plurals if needed). Not part of OccurrenceTimeFormatter unless clean.
5. Typed and spoken captures keep ONE path (captureAndInterpret) and the SAME rules as today: raw capture created exactly once and never touched again, submit only while started, speech sessions as implemented, undo window, AI-readiness check never downloads, nothing logged, no user words in any message string. Only the orchestrator/service types, the card model and the card actions change. `reloadRecent`/Recent list keep using loadHistory + toHistoryRow unchanged (tagged pairs already carry the 'subject action' label as the pair's display name).
6. Refusals from the tag services map to plain-words messages through a NEW `refusalMessage(TagRefusal)`-style function in ui/review (additive; keep the existing ServiceRefusal functions for History); e.g. a New name rejected (InvalidName reasons: reuse the existing reason copy where possible), tag no longer exists, entry already saved, time in the future. Messages are string resources and never contain the owner's words. IllegalArgumentException from a service (a race) is treated like any storage failure: keep the card, show 'log_action_failed'.

STRUCTURE (your call within these bounds): LogViewModel's constructor takes the tagged collaborators (repository: LedgerRepository, orchestrator: TaggedCaptureOrchestrator, resolution: TaggedResolutionService, correction: TaggedCorrectionService, transcriber, clock, isAiReady, zone, locale) and LogViewModelFactory wires them from the application; ResultCard variants, LogUiState (picker becomes a tag picker state with kind + catalog) and LogScreen/ResultCards change accordingly; remove the v3 picker/resolve/changeActivity paths from the LOG screen only. Keep the file/class names where sensible; keep the existing test-tag constants for cards that still exist and add new ones. The ui/review/* helpers History uses (ReviewSuggestions, PickerState, refusalMessageFor ...) must keep compiling and behaving; add, do not repurpose.

TESTS (JVM/Robolectric under app-phone/src/test, following the existing style; rewrite LogViewModelTest / LogTestFixtures / LogScreenTest / LogVoiceScreenTest onto the new model, keeping every behaviour that still applies -- one write site and raw-capture immutability, typed and voice on one path, speech session lifecycle, undo window timing/pausing, readiness check, storage-failure give-back of words, no words in messages -- and replacing the activity-picker scenarios with tag scenarios). The view model needs a LedgerRepository in tests: prefer the REAL Room ledger over a fake so tag semantics are not re-invented -- add a public in-memory factory beside createActivityRepository in core-data (e.g. `createInMemoryActivityRepository(context, clock)` in ActivityRepositories.kt or a sibling file, KDoc'd 'for tests', no behaviour difference) and use it under Robolectric with the real TaggedCaptureOrchestrator/services and a scripted ActivityExtractor (fake in test sources: returns scripted ExtractionResult per raw text). If that proves impossible, a delegating fake like TG3.1/TG3.3's is acceptable, but say why. Required scenarios: auto-saved typed entry shows Saved card with subject, action, duration and time; repeat entry reuses the same tags (second Saved card shows the same names); close match shows the Check card with the Near candidate options, nothing saved until Save, picking the candidate saves under the EXISTING tag and learns the alias (assert via the catalog), 'Keep mine' creates a new tag; Empty subject card requires a pick before Save is enabled; AI-unavailable shows the Check card with both sides blank and Save works after two picks; Decide later keeps the capture waiting without an occurrence; Undo hides; Change subject/action corrects (one correction, names refreshed, undo window still running); refusals show plain messages; voice capture reaches the same cards; compose-level tests for the Saved card (with/without duration), the Check card states (Near, pre-chosen, blank, Save disabled/enabled), the tag picker (filter, new name), and accessibility labels. Duration formatter tests.

DOCS: ADR-046 in docs/DECISIONS.md ('Log screen on the tag pipeline', Accepted, developer decision 2026-10-04, TG3.4): one Check card for confirm/review/unavailable, Save only with both sides chosen, nothing saved before Save, time from the proposal only when clean, pre-chosen vs near vs blank sides, aliases learned only through the services. Add a short 'Log result cards (tags)' note to docs/UX_SPEC.md OR docs/UX_VISUAL_SPEC.md wherever the old card list lives (update the card list; keep edits small and factual). No other doc changes.

RULES: no change to core-domain, core-ai, core-speech, wear code, app-wear, the History screens/view model (ui/history/**), HistoryRow, ActivityPicker, or the pipeline/wear packages; the only allowed core-data change is the in-memory factory; no logging; no user words in strings, messages, test names or exception messages; ML Kit stays in core-ai; strings only in resources, additive in strings.xml (do not delete strings History uses).

PATH NOTE (clarified 2026-10-04): the core modules (core-domain, core-ai, core-speech, core-testing, core-wear-protocol) are READ-ONLY for this task: reading them is allowed and expected; writing is excluded because write_paths does not list them. forbidden_paths lists only locations that must not be read-or-written by design.
non_goals: No History screen change (TG3.5), no tag management screen (TG3.6), no device run (TG3.7).
No change to the domain services or orchestrator; if one is needed report scope_change_requested.
No deletion of v3 classes; the v3 interpreter/orchestrator stay in CapturePipeline for History.
acceptance_criteria: Typed and spoken captures on the Log screen run through TaggedCaptureOrchestrator on the single existing capture path (raw capture created once, never modified, nothing logged); every TaggedProcessingOutcome maps to exactly one card or to a refreshed Recent list (AlreadyHasOccurrence).

The Saved card shows subject, action, optional duration and time, with Undo (unchanged behaviour incl. the undo window rules), Change subject and Change action (TaggedCorrectionService; names refresh; window keeps running).

The Check card covers NeedsConfirm, NeedsReview, Rejected and InterpreterUnavailable: pre-chosen sides, Near candidate options with 'Keep mine', blank sides needing a pick, Save enabled only with both sides chosen, nothing saved before Save, Save through TaggedResolutionService with the time rule (proposal time only when clean) and duration/state from the proposal, Decide later leaves the capture waiting.

A shared TagPicker (search by name and alias, type a new name, returns a TagChoice) exists with accessibility labels and touch targets matching ActivityPicker; ActivityPicker, HistoryRow and ui/history are unchanged and History tests still pass.
Tag-service refusals map to plain-words resource messages that never contain the owner's words; IllegalArgumentException from a service keeps the card and shows the generic failure message.

Duration formatting is tested; the view-model, screen and voice tests are rewritten onto the tag model and cover the scenarios listed in the objective, using the real Room ledger (in-memory factory in core-data) or, if impossible, a justified fake.

ADR-046 and the UX card-list note are written; the only core-data change is the in-memory repository factory; no forbidden path changed; all app-phone, core-data, core-domain and core-testing unit tests pass and :app-phone:assembleDebug and :app-phone:compileDebugAndroidTestKotlin succeed.
